title: HtmlTime
responsibility: Renders the native time element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlTime.attributes
inputs.description: Native time attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlTime.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native time element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlTime
outputs.description: The actual native time element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
